question: Where can I get a list of solar PV projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No national list of solar PV projects in permitting exists in the sources examined; permitting is split across federal (BLM) and state or local bodies. Best entry points: state registers (NY ORES, CEC Opt-In) and BLM ePlanning for federal land, plus EIA-860M as a national lead (1,100 planned PV generators with coordinates and approval-status codes, not a permit file).
main_caveats: No single federal body lists all projects; BLM covers only projects needing BLM action and state or county permits sit elsewhere.
EIA-860M status is survey-reported and undated, and the entity is not always the developer; the same applies to interconnection queues.
NY list and docket can disagree (Addison Solar 120 vs 105 MW); read the docket for the authoritative figures.
Only NY, California opt-in and two BLM pages were examined; Texas, Midwest, Southeast, Arizona and counties are pending.
BLM register records and the federal permitting dashboard could not be read from this environment.
answer.confidence_reason: Two state registers and a national lead were read; BLM records and the federal dashboard were not retrievable and most states were not examined.

attributes.note: EIA gives coordinates for all 1,100 planned PV rows; NY and CA give town/county only; BLM site geometry not reached.
attributes.gap_note: No tested permit register exposes site coordinates in text; BLM and CEC map layers were not opened.

attributes.note: EIA nameplate MW; NY MW inside description text; CEC 300 MW PV plus separate storage MW.
attributes.gap_note: Capacity bases differ (and NY list/docket disagree for Addison Solar); BLM pages read gave no MW.

attributes.note: NY and CEC name the applicant LLC; EIA gives the reporting entity, not always the developer.
attributes.gap_note: BLM pages read name no applicant; sponsor parent companies are usually absent.

attributes.note: NY stage by list section; CEC status and milestones; EIA codes L/T/U; BLM EIS/decision pages.
attributes.gap_note: Only NY, CA opt-in and a few BLM projects examined; other states, counties and the federal dashboard not read.

attributes.note: CEC dated milestones (filed 2024-08-01, Final Order 2026-04-27); NY dates only withdrawals; BLM Libra 2025-12-15.
attributes.gap_note: EIA status has no date; NY list has no date column; BLM register dates were not readable as text.

sources.name: EIA-860M Monthly Update, 'Planned' sheet (solar PV generators with status codes)
sources.format: XLSX (sheets Operating, Planned, Retired, Canceled or Postponed, plus Puerto Rico)
sources.summary: Monthly national workbook: 1,100 planned PV generators with coordinates, MW, owner entity and status (approvals pending/received, construction).
sources.coverage_note: Nationwide but survey-based and not a permitting register.
caveats: Status has no date; owner is not always the developer.
Does not prove permits; use it to find the project, then the agency file.

problems: Records_total counts solar PV rows in the Planned sheet.

sources.name: NY Office of Renewable Energy Siting (ORES) permit application lists and DPS case pages
sources.publisher: New York State Department of Public Service, Office of Renewable Energy Siting and Electric Transmission
sources.format: HTML list with links to CaseMaster docket pages
sources.summary: NY siting permits by stage with docket links; solar mixed with wind; capacity and location only in description text.
caveats: No date column; list and docket MW differ for Addison Solar.

problems: No export on the page; the data must be scraped from the HTML tables.
Docket page capture shows no status field and zero calendar entries; the filings tab lists 297 documents but rows were not captured.

example.example_request: Open https://dps.ny.gov/ores-permit-applications and follow the docket link of 'Addison Solar' (23-03015) to https://documents.dps.ny.gov/public/MatterManagement/CaseMaster.aspx?MatterSeq=85427&MNO=23-03015
example.example_result: List: 23-03015 Addison Solar, section Incomplete, 'ADDISON SOLAR, LLC', 120 MW, Steuben. Docket page: 'WEB Addison Solar, LLC', 105-megawatt, Towns of Addison, Campbell and Erwin; 297 filed documents; no status or key dates shown.
